title: The Hospital
content: Just woke up from a mall world dream where I was doing an inpatient stay at the hospital. I was in the physical therapy wing which had a bar in it? And one of the nurses gave me a drink with a drug in it. Anyone familiar with this area? I’ve been there once before. It’s where they have like colorful physical activities and exercises, including large ones that hang from the ceiling and can go up quite high. It also has a chain of rooms that are for the inpatient therapy patients with beds and a small bathroom and kitchen area. I’m really curious if anyone recognizes this place since I’ve definitely been here before myself.
